running.name: Qwen3.5-9B (pinned default, vision)
running.description: Always-hot light model; chat + simple tools + vision. Reserve ~7 GB · 32K ctx · 1 slot · 36.7 tok/s. Thinking model.

running.name: Qwen3.5-9B-NVFP4 (vLLM, bulk vision)
running.description: Qwen3.5-9B NVFP4 (compressed-tensors nvfp4-pack-quantized, ig1). Same weights family as the pinned llama.cpp qwen3.5-9b but 4x its image throughput: 83.0 img/min on 1536x1536 vs 20.8, and lower latency (p50 6.3 s vs 25.1 s at 8 concurrent). Vision tower stays BF16 - quantization_config.ignore excludes every model.visual.* layer - so the 4x is the runtime, not the quant. Reserve ~27 GB (util 0.22), 32K ctx, KV 350,021 tokens = 10.68x @32K. Cold start ~3.5 min. THINKING MODEL: send chat_template_kwargs {enable_thinking:false} or content AND reasoning_content both come back empty. Up to 20 images per request (--limit-mm-per-prompt). Weights on local GX10 NVMe; mirrored on ds1825.

running.name: SAM3 (image segmentation, FastAPI)
running.description: Text/box-prompted instance segmentation (facebook/sam3) -> masks + boxes + scores. NOT a chat model: POST /upstream/sam3/segment with multipart image + text. Runs fp16 with a micro-batching queue (1 worker, batch 4): ~3 req/s at ~2.1 s. GET /upstream/sam3/stats for load, /docs for the API. Reserve ~7 GB.

running.name: ShieldGemma 2 4B (image safety classifier)
running.description: Image -> P(violation) for the policies dangerous, sexual and violence. No OpenAI route: POST /upstream/shieldgemma-2-4b-it/classify (multipart image, optional policies, threshold). Cold ~56 s (NAS) · warm ~1.4 s for all three policies · Reserve ~12 GB.

running.name: SigLIP2 SO400M/16 @512 · image + text · 1152-d
running.description: Image AND text -> one shared 1152-d space (L2-normalized). Fixed 512x512 input (squash, no crop; not NaFlex, max_num_patches returns 400). Most image detail (1024 patches, 4x the patches of @256) and the slowest of the three; use for small text and fine detail. Text is padded to 64 tokens. POST /v1/embeddings with data:image/...;base64 URIs or plain text. Cold start ~14 s · warm ~130 ms per 2 images · Reserve ~7 GB.
